title: claude-settings guard: a lane session opens its PR as a draft
why: Lane photo-fetch-order opened PR 263 ready at 2026-11-08 23:17 CST. Its red-proof macOS run counted as batch CI, so the merge tool refused batch PR 262's merge at 23:55 CST. The coordinator told the lane to flip PR 263 to draft.
note: Feedback for claude-settings, which the owner carries (sessions never edit claude-settings). Proposed guard: refuse a ready (non-draft) PR create, or a flip to ready, from a cs-build:lane session; only the batch runner's integration PR goes ready (rule git-integration-branch-merge). Reported by the coordinator, 2026-11-08 23:55 CST. Filed in phase tooling with the other claude-settings steps.
